name: @gjsify/gtk-runtime-win32-x64
description: Batteries-included GTK/GObject-Introspection runtime bundle for Windows x64 — lets @gjsify/node-gi load gi:// namespaces (GLib/GObject/Gio/cairo/Pango/Graphene/Gdk) with NO gvsbuild/system GTK. Platform-gated (win32/x64 only).

gaps.why: MP3 is DECODED on this target, by `mfmp3dec` out of the `mediafoundation` plugin (gst-plugins-bad), which wraps the MP3 decoder Windows itself ships — see the `MP3` claim. This entry is the OTHER decoder, the one the darwin bundles use: gst-plugins-good's `mpg123` links libmpg123, and the gvsbuild version this bundle is built from defines no project for that library, so the element cannot be built here. It stays declared, with `upstream`, so the day gvsbuild gains the project this bundle can ship the same decoder as darwin and stop depending on the OS component. What the OS route costs, stated because it is not nothing: Media Foundation is absent from Windows N editions until the Media Feature Pack is installed, and is the optional Server-Media-Foundation feature on Windows Server — where mfplat.dll is missing the plugin does not load and MP3 is the gap it was before (ADR 0056 § 7).

the gst-plugins-good element links libFLAC and gvsbuild defines no project for that library either — the same absence as MP3, read off the same project list, and neither is a licensing decision: libmpg123 is LGPL-2.1 and libFLAC is BSD-3-Clause. Measured in the same Windows 11 run against the published 0.48.0 bundle: `flacdec` resolves to NULL (#1626). Unlike MP3 this one has a route out of the pinned catalogue and is therefore a COSTED decision rather than an absence: gvsbuild builds gst-plugins-rs under the project name `gst-plugin-gtk4`, and that tree's `claxon` feature is a pure-Rust FLAC decoder (`claxondec`, MPL-2.0). It is not taken — ADR 0056 § Alternatives rejected carries the price: cargo-c plus gst-plugins-bad and gtk4 rebuilt from source, on the leg whose GStreamer build already runs under a 150-minute timeout, to close the one of the two gaps no consumer has been measured needing. A libFLAC project in gvsbuild closes it in one word instead.

the modern Windows sink, and the one absence here that costs no format: `directsound` ships and `autoaudiosink` resolves to it. Declared because it is the same silent absence, not because anything breaks.

`isomp4` demuxes the container and `audioparsers` supplies `aacparse`, after which the stream reaches no decoder at all. The two elements that would decode it are `faad` (gst-plugins-bad, GPL) and `avdec_aac` (libav, whose whole closure these bundles refuse), so shipping one is a redistribution decision for whoever ships the product rather than this bundle's. NOT MEASURED on this target since the `mediafoundation` plugin arrived for MP3: it registers `mfaacdec` beside `mfmp3dec`, the OS decoder with no redistribution question attached, so AAC may already decode here. It stays a gap until a fixture proves it, because a claim is only made where a test decodes it.
